title: [Soup´s] Variated Roses
description: A small texture pack that adds the rose and cyan rose back into Minecraft, with a modern flare.
body:
A small texture pack that adds back the rose and the cyan rose from MC:PE with some modern flare. This **texture pack is WIP** in that it's missing the custom textures for potted plants. Until I figure out how to do it, I'll release the version that I have now ´°˘°`"

Inspired by texture packs such as https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/spring-flowers/gallery
